fields.title: 📖 Ibn ʿAbbās: Kufr dūna Kufr regarding al-Māʾidah 5:44
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿAbbās:**

> ***“Regarding ‘Whoever does not judge according to what Allah has sent down,’ Ibn ʿAbbās explained: It is Kufr, but not like the Kufr of one who denies Allah, His angels, His books and His messengers. Ṭāwūs and ʿAṭāʾ explained this as Kufr below Kufr.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Āyah is tremendous, but the Salaf made Tafṣīl: whoever acknowledges Allah’s judgment and deviates sinfully does not automatically fall into Kufr Akbar.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr al-Qurʾān al-ʿAẓīm, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Māʾidah 5:44; mit Überlieferungen von Ibn ʿAbbās, Ṭāwūs und ʿAṭāʾ.
